decision: NX-029 slice 1 (design docs/implementation/NX-029-design.md §3, owner decisions D1–D7 'all as recommended' 2026-10-10, dispatcher D8/D9): tenant-level retention (D9) for the classes the retention keeper executes in slice 1. Product defaults, not legal periods (03:96, 13:31); enterprises adjust by a new version. A derived class never outlives its source (prompt text, Claim quotes and job inputs follow the message text). Financial records and cost entries use financial_retention_days of the commercial settings (NX-027 D6), not a second value here. Expired message text, Claim quotes, prompt text and job inputs are redacted in place (rows, digests and order stay); commercial receipts, metric observations, commercial records and cost entries are deleted; every pass leaves a tombstone without content. v2 (NX-029 slice 4, NX-035 D4 confirmed by the owner 2026-10-10): records — deletion ledger and tombstones are kept 365 days, longer than the 35-day maximum backup retention, so every deletion still in a backup can be replayed after a restore (NX-035 §5, §6.2); a version with backup_max_retention_days not below both is refused. v3 (NX-029 final, AT-026): three expiry classes the keeper now executes - run_files: a Pi Run directory 30 days after its Run is terminal (queued for the Agent Host runs/purge, deleted only when the Host confirms; ADR-005, 06:92); commitment_closed: a Commitment 365 days after it was closed (fulfilled, cancelled or breached), object and ledger deleted (D4); claim_superseded: the structured value and remaining text of a superseded Claim 365 days after it was superseded, ids and the correction chain kept (D2).
